title: Q-CLAIM-COVER-brand-public-profile-profile-README-md: unbound claim-like statements on brand/public-profile/profile/README.md
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** claims coverage, every PR and daily
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/claims.json::"surface": "brand/public-profile/profile/README.md"
**Status:** open

COVERAGE-1: 1 claim-like lines (first 1) on `brand/public-profile/profile/README.md` state a number, cadence or guarantee with no registered claim and probe.

size: S
